title: Asymptotically Efficient Finite Impulse Response System Identification without Noise Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2611.34039v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Efficient identification of finite impulse response systems under unknown or heavy-tailed noise remains a challenge in system identification. Classical estimators, including least squares (LS) and robust alternatives like least absolute deviations (LAD), are often sensitive to outliers or statistically inefficient when noise characteristics deviate from their underlying assumptions. To address this, we propose a novel class of adaptive estimators that achieves asymptotic efficiency without requiring prior knowledge of the noise distribution. Our approach leverages kernel density estimation to construct two nonparametric maximum likelihood-type estimators: the estimated maximum likelihood estimator (eMLE) and the estimated profiled MLE (epMLE). tldr: 提出了一类无需噪声分布先验知识的自适应估计器（eMLE与epMLE），通过核密度估计和一致性初始估计的残差来近似似然函数，在未知或重尾噪声下实现了有限脉冲响应系统辨识的渐近有效性。
en_tdlr: Proposes a novel class of adaptive estimators (eMLE and epMLE) that achieve asymptotic efficiency in finite impulse response system identification under unknown or heavy-tailed noise, without requiring prior knowledge of the noise distribution, by using kernel density estimation to approximate the likelihood from residuals of consistent initial estimates.
